newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Former Belgian PM Leburton dies.
newsitem.headline: Former Belgian PM Leburton dies.

text.p: Former Belgian prime minister Edmond Leburton has died in hospital at the age of 82, police in the southern Belgian town of Waremme said on Monday.
Leburton, the only French-speaking socialist ever to become head of Belgium's government, died on Sunday evening.

He became a minister in 1954 and prime minister in 1973, remaining in power for almost one year until his government fell over an oil contract with Iran which a sparked linguistic row between French-speaking Wallonia and Dutch-speaking Flanders regions.
